## Decision needed

What architectural question or boundary needs a durable decision?

## Existing authority

What Product Law, policy, architecture, or skill documents already constrain the decision?

## Options considered

### Option A

### Option B

### Other

## Decision

State the chosen approach and why.

## Consequences

What becomes easier, harder, required, or prohibited because of this decision?

## Product Law impact

- [ ] No Product Law change; this decision implements existing authority.
- [ ] A possible Product Law change was discovered and must be reconciled separately before implementation.

## Verification / evidence

How will we know the decision is correctly represented in the implementation?

## Next implementation checkpoint

What is the next bounded action after the decision is settled?
